result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity, so WH-1 shows only "Bolt 10" in your example. The full suite passes (608 tests, 0 failures). Nothing is committed.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockStore.java`**: `listInWarehouse` adds `AND s.quantity > 0` to its query, matching the other overviews. I also updated its Javadoc to say so.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: new test `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNoStock`. It takes all nuts out, sets screws to 0, and checks the list is only bolts and that the nut quantity is still 0.
